images.caption: Kmart Brunswick, OH

brief: 1970s discount department store at the edge of town: a big one-storey concrete-block box with a flat roof, a raised sign band over the entrance, an attached garden centre and a huge parking lot; next to a small strip of shops.

facade.notes: a former 1970s Kmart (Brunswick OH): a long plain concrete-block box, the side wall cut with a row of overhead doors into service bays (now a tire/auto service business), pickups parked along the side lot, light poles, trees on the lot edge

why.note: the discount store: one huge single-storey box at the edge of town, a sea of parking in front sized for the year's busiest day
an old discount box chopped into an auto-service shop: big boxes are reused by trades that want floor area and doors
